verdict: Clear, commented configuration; secrets correctly kept out of vars. One interaction worth fixing: the 30-day R2 lifecycle on stats/ can delete a share's live index while its KV pointer still names it.

findings.title: Do not let the stats/ lifecycle expire a live index
findings.scenario: A share with indexSchedule 'monthly' (full walk due at 30 days minus one hour) misses one nightly cron, or a share is paused for more than 30 days and then resumed.
findings.consequence: stats/<slug>.json and .files.json are deleted by the 30-day rule while share-stats:<slug> still points at them: folder tiles lose their counts and covers, the Pipelines tab still reports 'Indexed N d ago', and the next orphan sweep sees no file rows for that share and deletes all of its R2 thumbnails.
findings.fix: Drop the lifecycle rule for stats/ (the blobs are small and rewritten by every walk) and clean them up explicitly in deleteShare instead; or make loadStats treat a missing blob as 'not indexed' and clear the pointer so a walk is scheduled.
